conditional_replication.score: mean of two independent MC accuracy checks; not a probability ensemble
conditional_replication.interval: paired Student t, df4; exploratory and conditional on shared baseline, bank and validation set
conditional_replication.selection: no seed/case omission, no reselection from independent MC

selection: original MC selection; no case/epoch re-selection from high-sample audit
limits: Repeated deterministic controls across objective/scale versions are not independent training replicates. CEA is the paper compactness proxy, not human semantic quality.
